claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Riluzole at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells broadly; its known pharmacology (sodium channel blockade, glutamate release inhibition, K2P channel activation) is not cytotoxic, and any weak, selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect sodium channel blockade or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a canonical cytotoxic mechanism.
